boundaries.state: Local native Miniflare D1, not hosted D1

boundaries.sender: Reviewed diagnostic sender with custom check name; production sendGitHubCheck is not exercised
boundaries.hostedEvidence: Separate hosted state fixtures; this is not a combined hosted-state/actual-sender result
boundaries.blockedUpload: Automatic approval review rejected the separate GitHub credential upload command before execution. That command never read, copied, or uploaded the installation-token payload. No equivalent upload was retried.

localMock.transport: Strict local HTTP mock; no outbound GitHub requests

boundaries.sender: Diagnostic adapter with a custom check name; production sendGitHubCheck is not exercised

boundaries.clocks: Injected logical lease clocks; GitHub completed_at uses wall time
boundaries.delay: Known HTTP 200 is fully read before callback completion is withheld
boundaries.ambiguity: Injected callback exception after a known HTTP 200; no claim of actual network response loss
boundaries.creation: One new check only; no adoption of existing IDs, search, or retry
boundaries.parent: Caller must durably reserve its probe prefix before invoking the adapter
